name: port_developers_seaport_map
description: Section 12 test 9: on a 4 x 3 map with water cells (0,0), (1,0), (1,1) and (3,2), the seaport's Init builds the sea-access map: (0,0), (1,0), (1,1) are 0x83 (one body touching the z = 0 row, bit 1, and the x = 0 column, bit 2), (3,2) is 0x8C (the z = 2 row, bit 8, and the x = 3 column, bit 4), every other cell 0. CityHasSea is true. A seaport whose lot covers only (2,1) has no access; GetCellSeaAccess outside the map answers 0 [choice]. A lake that touches no edge stays 0x80 and does not make a sea.
